dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Several prominent, irregularly shaped 'O' and 'C' structures are visible on the dorsal surface with jagged, high-contrast white boundaries. The transition from the high-intensity white edges to the dark charcoal interior of the structures is abrupt with sharp pixel gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of solid high-intensity white pixels are concentrated within the interstices between the larger ring structures. A higher density of these non-gradient blobs is observed on the upper-right posterior quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three dominant macro-annuli positioned along the mid-dorsal ridge form a nearly linear chain. Connecting these centroids to two smaller, distinct rings on the upper posterior creates an elongated, irregular pentagonal spatial relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: The larger ring structures are interconnected by a series of thin, high-contrast white filaments, creating a dendritic or web-like network across the visible dorsal region.
